tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: American War Mothers (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Place of Incorporation.—
tree.text: The corporation is declared to be incorporated in the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Period of Existence.—
tree.text: The corporation may continue to exist until there are no individuals who qualify for membership.
